cmp.elb1905: Und sie kamen an das jenseitige Ufer des Sees in das Land der Gadarener.
cmp.bsb: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.
cmp.kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
cmp.rv1909: Y VINIERON de la otra parte de la mar á la provincia de los Gadarenos.

cmp.elb1905: Und als er aus dem Schiff gestiegen war, begegnete ihm alsbald aus den Grüften ein Mensch mit einem unreinen Geiste,
cmp.bsb: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
cmp.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
cmp.rv1909: Y salido él del barco, luego le salió al encuentro, de los sepulcros, un hombre con un espíritu inmundo,

cmp.elb1905: der seine Wohnung in den Grabstätten hatte; und selbst mit Ketten konnte keiner ihn binden,
cmp.bsb: This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.
cmp.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
cmp.rv1909: Que tenía domicilio en los sepulcros, y ni aun con cadenas le podía alguien atar;

cmp.elb1905: da er oft mit Fußfesseln und mit Ketten gebunden gewesen, und die Ketten von ihm in Stücke zerrissen und die Fußfesseln zerrieben worden waren; und niemand vermochte ihn zu bändigen.
cmp.bsb: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
cmp.kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
cmp.rv1909: Porque muchas veces había sido atado con grillos y cadenas, mas las cadenas habían sido hechas pedazos por él, y los grillos desmenuzados; y nadie le podía domar.

cmp.elb1905: Und allezeit, Nacht und Tag, war er in den Grabstätten und auf den Bergen und schrie und zerschlug sich mit Steinen.
cmp.bsb: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
cmp.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
cmp.rv1909: Y siempre, de día y de noche, andaba dando voces en los montes y en los sepulcros, é hiriéndose con las piedras.

cmp.elb1905: Als er aber Jesum von ferne sah, lief er und warf sich vor ihm nieder;
cmp.bsb: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
cmp.kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
cmp.rv1909: Y como vió á Jesús de lejos, corrió, y le adoró.

cmp.elb1905: und mit lauter Stimme schreiend, sagt er: Was habe ich mit dir zu schaffen, Jesu, Sohn Gottes, des Höchsten? Ich beschwöre dich bei Gott, quäle mich nicht!
cmp.bsb: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
cmp.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
cmp.rv1909: Y clamando á gran voz, dijo: ¿Qué tienes conmigo, Jesús, Hijo del Dios Altísimo? Te conjuro por Dios que no me atormentes.

cmp.elb1905: Denn er sagte zu ihm: Fahre aus, du unreiner Geist, aus dem Menschen.
cmp.bsb: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
cmp.kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
cmp.rv1909: Porque le decía: Sal de este hombre, espíritu inmundo.

cmp.elb1905: Und er fragte ihn: Was ist dein Name? Und er spricht zu ihm: Legion ist mein Name, denn wir sind viele.
cmp.bsb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
cmp.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
cmp.rv1909: Y le preguntó: ¿Cómo te llamas? Y respondió diciendo: Legión me llamo; porque somos muchos.

cmp.elb1905: Und er bat ihn sehr, daß er sie nicht aus der Gegend fortschicken möchte.
cmp.bsb: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
cmp.kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
cmp.rv1909: Y le rogaba mucho que no le enviase fuera de aquella provincia.

cmp.elb1905: Es war aber daselbst an dem Berge eine große Herde Schweine, welche weidete.
cmp.bsb: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
cmp.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
cmp.rv1909: Y estaba allí cerca del monte una grande manada de puercos paciendo.

cmp.elb1905: Und sie baten ihn und sprachen: Schicke uns in die Schweine, daß wir in sie fahren.
cmp.bsb: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
cmp.kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
cmp.rv1909: Y le rogaron todos los demonios, diciendo: Envíanos á los puercos para que entremos en ellos.

cmp.elb1905: Und Jesus erlaubte es ihnen alsbald. Und die unreinen Geister fuhren aus und fuhren in die Schweine, und die Herde stürzte sich den Abhang hinab in den See, (bei zweitausend) und sie ertranken in dem See.
cmp.bsb: He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.
cmp.kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
cmp.rv1909: Y luego Jesús se lo permitió. Y saliendo aquellos espíritus inmundos, entraron en los puercos, y la manada cayó por un despeñadero en la mar; los cuales eran como dos mil; y en la mar se ahogaron.

cmp.elb1905: Und die Hüter flohen und verkündeten es in der Stadt und auf dem Lande; und sie gingen hinaus, um zu sehen, was geschehen war.
cmp.bsb: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
cmp.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
cmp.rv1909: Y los que apacentaban los puercos huyeron, y dieron aviso en la ciudad y en los campos. Y salieron para ver qué era aquello que había acontecido.

cmp.elb1905: Und sie kommen zu Jesu und sehen den Besessenen sitzen, bekleidet und vernünftig, den, der die Legion gehabt hatte; und sie fürchteten sich.
cmp.bsb: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
cmp.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
cmp.rv1909: Y vienen á Jesús, y ven al que había sido atormentado del demonio, y que había tenido la legión, sentado y vestido, y en su juicio cabal; y tuvieron miedo.

cmp.elb1905: Und die es gesehen hatten, erzählten ihnen, wie dem Besessenen geschehen war, und das von den Schweinen.
cmp.bsb: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
cmp.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
cmp.rv1909: Y les contaron los que lo habían visto, cómo había acontecido al que había tenido el demonio, y lo de los puercos.

cmp.elb1905: Und sie fingen an, ihm zuzureden, aus ihren Grenzen wegzugehen.
cmp.bsb: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
cmp.kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
cmp.rv1909: Y comenzaron á rogarle que se fuese de los términos de ellos.

cmp.elb1905: Und als er in das Schiff stieg, bat ihn der Besessene, daß er bei ihm sein dürfe.
cmp.bsb: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
cmp.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
cmp.rv1909: Y entrando él en el barco, le rogaba el que había sido fatigado del demonio, para estar con él.

cmp.elb1905: Und er ließ es ihm nicht zu, sondern spricht zu ihm: Gehe hin nach deinem Hause zu den Deinigen und verkünde ihnen, wieviel der Herr an dir getan, und wie er sich deiner erbarmt hat.
cmp.bsb: But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”
cmp.kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
cmp.rv1909: Mas Jesús no le permitió, sino le dijo: Vete á tu casa, á los tuyos, y cuéntales cuán grandes cosas el Señor ha hecho contigo, y cómo ha tenido misericordia de ti.

cmp.elb1905: Und er ging hin und fing an, in der Dekapolis auszurufen, wieviel Jesus an ihm getan hatte; und alle verwunderten sich.
cmp.bsb: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
cmp.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
cmp.rv1909: Y se fué, y comenzó á publicar en Decápolis cuán grandes cosas Jesús había hecho con él: y todos se maravillaban.

cmp.elb1905: Und als Jesus in dem Schiffe wieder an das jenseitige Ufer hinübergefahren war, versammelte sich eine große Volksmenge zu ihm; und er war am See.
cmp.bsb: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
cmp.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
cmp.rv1909: Y pasando otra vez Jesús en un barco á la otra parte, se juntó á él gran compañía; y estaba junto á la mar.

cmp.elb1905: Und siehe, es kommt einer der Synagogenvorsteher, mit Namen Jairus, und als er ihn sieht, fällt er ihm zu Füßen;
cmp.bsb: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
cmp.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
cmp.rv1909: Y vino uno de los príncipes de la sinagoga, llamado Jairo; y luego que le vió, se postró á sus pies,

cmp.elb1905: und er bat ihn sehr und sprach: Mein Töchterlein liegt in den letzten Zügen; ich bitte, daß du kommest und ihr die Hände auflegest, auf daß sie gerettet werde und lebe.
cmp.bsb: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
cmp.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
cmp.rv1909: Y le rogaba mucho, diciendo: Mi hija está á la muerte: ven y pondrás las manos sobre ella para que sea salva, y vivirá.

cmp.elb1905: Und er ging mit ihm, und eine große Volksmenge folgte ihm und drängte ihn.
cmp.bsb: So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
cmp.kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
cmp.rv1909: Y fué con él, y le seguía gran compañía, y le apretaban.

cmp.elb1905: Und ein Weib, das zwölf Jahre mit einem Blutfluß behaftet war,
cmp.bsb: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
cmp.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
cmp.rv1909: Y una mujer que estaba con flujo de sangre doce años hacía,

cmp.elb1905: und vieles erlitten hatte von vielen Ärzten und alle ihre Habe verwandt und keinen Nutzen davon gehabt hatte (es war vielmehr schlimmer mit ihr geworden), kam,
cmp.bsb: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
cmp.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
cmp.rv1909: Y había sufrido mucho de muchos médicos, y había gastado todo lo que tenía, y nada había aprovechado, antes le iba peor,

cmp.elb1905: als sie von Jesu gehört, in der Volksmenge von hinten und rührte sein Kleid an;
cmp.bsb: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
cmp.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
cmp.rv1909: Como oyó hablar de Jesús, llegó por detrás entre la compañía, y tocó su vestido.

cmp.elb1905: denn sie sprach: Wenn ich nur seine Kleider anrühre, so werde ich geheilt werden.
cmp.bsb: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
cmp.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
cmp.rv1909: Porque decía: Si tocare tan solamente su vestido, seré salva.

cmp.elb1905: Und alsbald vertrocknete der Quell ihres Blutes, und sie merkte am Leibe, daß sie von der Plage geheilt war.
cmp.bsb: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
cmp.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
cmp.rv1909: Y luego la fuente de su sangre se secó; y sintió en el cuerpo que estaba sana de aquel azote.

cmp.elb1905: Und alsbald erkannte Jesus in sich selbst die Kraft, die von ihm ausgegangen war, wandte sich um in der Volksmenge und sprach: Wer hat meine Kleider angerührt?
cmp.bsb: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
cmp.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
cmp.rv1909: Y luego Jesús, conociendo en sí mismo la virtud que había salido de él, volviéndose á la compañía, dijo: ¿Quién ha tocado mis vestidos?

cmp.elb1905: Und seine Jünger sprachen zu ihm: Du siehst, daß die Volksmenge dich drängt, und du sprichst: Wer hat mich angerührt?
cmp.bsb: His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
cmp.kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
cmp.rv1909: Y le dijeron sus discípulos: Ves que la multitud te aprieta, y dices: ¿Quién me ha tocado?

cmp.elb1905: Und er blickte umher, um sie zu sehen, die dieses getan hatte.
cmp.bsb: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
cmp.kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
cmp.rv1909: Y él miraba alrededor para ver á la que había hecho esto.

cmp.elb1905: Das Weib aber, voll Furcht und Zittern, wissend, was ihr geschehen war, kam und fiel vor ihm nieder und sagte ihm die ganze Wahrheit.
cmp.bsb: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
cmp.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
cmp.rv1909: Entonces la mujer, temiendo y temblando, sabiendo lo que en sí había sido hecho, vino y se postró delante de él, y le dijo toda la verdad.

cmp.elb1905: Er aber sprach zu ihr: Tochter, dein Glaube hat dich geheilt; gehe hin in Frieden und sei gesund von deiner Plage.
cmp.bsb: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
cmp.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
cmp.rv1909: Y él le dijo: Hija, tu fe te ha hecho salva: ve en paz, y queda sana de tu azote.

cmp.elb1905: Während er noch redete, kommen sie von dem Synagogenvorsteher und sagen: Deine Tochter ist gestorben; was bemühst du den Lehrer noch?
cmp.bsb: While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
cmp.kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
cmp.rv1909: Hablando aún él, vinieron de casa del príncipe de la sinagoga, diciendo: Tu hija es muerta; ¿para qué fatigas más al Maestro?

cmp.elb1905: Als aber Jesus das Wort reden hörte, spricht er alsbald zu dem Synagogenvorsteher: Fürchte dich nicht; glaube nur.
cmp.bsb: But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
cmp.kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
cmp.rv1909: Mas luego Jesús, oyendo esta razón que se decía, dijo al príncipe de la sinagoga: No temas, cree solamente.

cmp.elb1905: Und er erlaubte niemand, ihn zu begleiten, außer Petrus und Jakobus und Johannes, dem Bruder des Jakobus.
cmp.bsb: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
cmp.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
cmp.rv1909: Y no permitió que alguno viniese tras él sino Pedro, y Jacobo, y Juan hermano de Jacobo.

cmp.elb1905: Und sie kommen in das Haus des Synagogenvorstehers, und er sieht ein Getümmel und Weinende und laut Heulende.
cmp.bsb: When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
cmp.kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
cmp.rv1909: Y vino á casa del príncipe de la sinagoga, y vió el alboroto, los que lloraban y gemían mucho.

words.es: se les está haciendo gritar ruidosamente

cmp.elb1905: Und als er eingetreten war, spricht er zu ihnen: Was lärmet und weinet ihr? Das Kind ist nicht gestorben, sondern es schläft.
cmp.bsb: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”
cmp.kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
cmp.rv1909: Y entrando, les dice: ¿Por qué alborotáis y lloráis? La muchacha no es muerta, mas duerme.

words.es: está yendo en camino hacia dentro

cmp.elb1905: Und sie verlachten ihn. Als er aber alle hinausgetrieben hatte, nimmt er den Vater des Kindes und die Mutter und die bei ihm waren mit und geht hinein, wo das Kind lag.
cmp.bsb: And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
cmp.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
cmp.rv1909: Y hacían burla de él: mas él, echados fuera todos, toma al padre y á la madre de la muchacha, y á los que estaban con él, y entra donde la muchacha estaba.

cmp.elb1905: Und indem er das Kind bei der Hand ergriff, spricht er zu ihm: Talitha kumi! das ist verdolmetscht: Mägdlein, ich sage dir, stehe auf!
cmp.bsb: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
cmp.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
cmp.rv1909: Y tomando la mano de la muchacha, le dice: Talitha cumi; que es, si lo interpretares: Muchacha, á ti digo, levántate.

cmp.elb1905: Und alsbald stand das Mägdlein auf und wandelte umher, denn es war zwölf Jahre alt. Und sie erstaunten mit großem Erstaunen.
cmp.bsb: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. She was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded.
cmp.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
cmp.rv1909: Y luego la muchacha se levantó, y andaba; porque tenía doce años. Y se espantaron de grande espanto.

cmp.elb1905: Und er gebot ihnen dringend, daß niemand dies erführe, und hieß ihr zu essen geben.
cmp.bsb: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
cmp.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
cmp.rv1909: Mas él les mandó mucho que nadie lo supiese, y dijo que le diesen de comer.
